title: Anvil Dragon Painting
description: A metal dragon with bat-like wings and a spiral eye sits on a copper anvil, vomiting yellow liquid covered in paint that pools on the cracked floor. Floating nearby are a hammer labeled Nurhan, a chisel, and pliers, all set against yellow cracked walls covered in paint marks and writing.
prompt: A surreal fantasy painting shows a metallic dragon with bat wings and a spiral eye perched on a large copper anvil. The dragon is vomiting a stream of thick yellow liquid covered in paint that drips down and forms a swirling pool on the cracked floor. A hammer, chisel, and pliers float in the air nearby. The entire scene takes place in a room with cracked yellow walls and floor covered in paint marks and writing.
